title: Hybrid Lizardman
paragraphs: “What exactly happened this time?”
After the loop, I put in even more effort. Specifically, this time I had Ren, not Itsuki, play the role of setting up the trap for Father.

That turned out to be surprisingly difficult. I had a hard time preventing the Crimson Swine from reaching Itsuki. Well, when she first brought the chainmail to me, I pointed out that it was stolen, and then went straight to the tavern where Itsuki was drinking and joined him for a drink. The Crimson Swine turned on her heel and left as soon as she saw me—it was hilarious. This time, I’ll make sure to meet Filo-tan and put an end to the Crimson Swine’s breath.
Well, the next day, the Crimson Swine, with dark circles under her eyes, was next to Ren. Ren’s group had already progressed quite far. Rather, it’s creepy that the Crimson Swine was found.
“To do such a thing to your comrades even after coming to another world—you’re scum. You’re really just a frivolous guy! I hate people like you!”
She was insulting Father with such lines.
Aren’t you the embarrassing Dark Holy Hero <Shadow Saint> afflicted with chuunibyou?

Hahaha! Well, it’s a good lesson that even the skeptical Ren loses his calm judgment when whispered to by the Crimson Swine on the first day. Or so I thought, but about three days later, the Crimson Swine had already returned to the castle. Well, it was clear to everyone that her facade would crumble sooner in front of Ren than in front of Itsuki. In this loop, mysterious assassins occasionally appeared before me. According to Trash, they were assassins from Siltvelt, but it’s obvious who the enemy is. Two months have passed since I saw Father’s grim demeanor, including the last time…
My stomach has started to develop ulcers. Lately, I’ve been relying on medicine. Putting that aside, Big Sister is pointing at the commotion in the courtyard.
“Again, you… Why are you there!”
“Is there a problem?”
“There’s a huge problem!”

Well, even I can tell there’s a bit of a difference. The one glaring at Ren in the courtyard with a weapon in hand is a large, muscular Lizardman. He looks like a crocodile and is very muscular. I don’t really understand how Father ended up with a Lizardman as a companion. I think he bought a human-like Lizardman with a fixed gaze about two weeks after the summoning…
How did that turn into this? He seems to have very high attack power. He looks like a warrior.
“Don’t interfere! He insulted my master. Don’t you understand that I wish to be with my master?”

The Crimson Swine appeared before Father and apparently shouted, “You rapist! You’re still in a place like this!” She was crying and wailing, “Boo! Boo!”—it made me want to kill her. Just as Father was about to lose it and raise his hand, Trash intervened using his authority, forcibly restrained the Lizardman, and ordered a duel between Ren and Father. Trash said that it’s unacceptable for a hero to use a slave, and he seemed intent on executing him as punishment for raising his hand against the Crimson Swine. And so, Ren was chosen as Father’s executioner, being the favorite of Trash and the Crimson Swine, and the one with a grudge against him. Ren, getting carried away, tilted his head slightly but still told Father that he’d forgive him if he apologized to the Crimson Swine.
“If I win, I go free, right?” Father said, and Ren nodded.

Itsuki, watching, tilted his head as well. Why was there even a need to fight? It was all pretty forced. The Crimson Swine just wanted Ren to kill Father, and since Ren wasn’t the type to get angry over using a slave, she was trying to force a duel. Well, the result was just like when I fought Father. Just when he had Ren pinned, the Crimson Swine cast support magic from behind. It looked like Father lost the match, but then the Lizardman transformed like he awakened and stood before Ren to protect Father.
“Eh? Eh? Like a crocodile? Some kind of gator?”
Father also looked dumbfounded, staring at the Lizardman.
“It’s me, great Shield Hero… It seems I’ve awakened to the power of my blood, and taken on this form…”
The Lizardman helped Father to his feet and hugged him. He went from looking like a half-breed to more of a beastman now.
“That duel just now—you cast magic from behind when it looked like Naofumi-san was about to win, didn’t you? Is interfering with a sacred duel considered just in this country?”
“What? She did that?”
“Yes, Ren-san, didn’t you find it strange how Naofumi-san suddenly staggered while you had him pinned?”
“Bubububu!”
“That’s outrageous. I suspected something was up from the start.”
“Right? If she didn’t want to see him, why did she go out of her way to show her face?”
“…Did Naofumi really commit rape?”
“Heroes! Just because you’re from the same other world, stop siding with each other! Hmph. Very well. I’ll overlook this disgrace—for now.”
At that moment, the mood started to shift in Father’s favor, and Trash and the Crimson Swine forcefully left. The Crimson Swine looked extremely frustrated.
“Shield Hero-sama, are you alright?”
The Lizardman then began checking over Father’s condition.
“Y-yeah, I’m fine.”
“I see… I feared something might have happened to you…”
And so, it seemed the Lizardman was genuinely worried about Father. Then, he forcibly carried Father on his back and started walking.
“I will always be on your side. I am a piece in the Shield Hero-sama’s hand… please, allow me to stay by your side as a slave…”
“Ah, yeah…”
With a deeply moved expression, Father buried his face into the Lizardman’s back. Judging by the mood, he was probably crying.
“…I feel like I did something wrong.”
Ren and Itsuki watched that scene with conflicted looks on their faces.
“We’ll finally get to meet Filo-tan!”
“…I doubt this is going to go well though.”
“It’ll be fine in the end. I’m sure this time it’ll work!”
“No, it probably won’t…”

My heart is full of anticipation. In a few days, I’ll get to see Filo-tan. Incidentally, it was a failure. Just like last time, it ended up being a voluptuous version of Filo-tan. But there was a slight difference. Specifically, this one had more of an American glamour vibe than last time.
“I knew it would turn out like this!”
This time, Big Sister said that as she watched Father and the voluptuous Filo-like Filolial-sama come out of the tent.
“This is strange, isn’t it?”
“What’s strange is your head! Do you understand?! We don’t have time!”
Mmm… Big Sister’s anger is growing.
“Sakura-chan isn’t Filo-tan after all!”
“Be quiet! If you had protected things properly, we wouldn’t be in this mess! You just needed to let me meet Naofumi-sama!”
However… it seems that, due to someone who sides with false accusations, Father is going to change which slave he purchases. No matter the outcome after that, everyone ends up admiring Father.
“Do you understand? Is your loyalty to Naofumi-sama something you fulfill by running away from unpleasant tasks?”
“What did you say!?”

Loyalty to Father… it’s true, I’ve been pushing the unpleasant roles onto Ren and Itsuki because I didn’t want to be the one to hurt Father. Could that half-hearted loyalty be what led to this result?
“Understood! I, Motoyasu, will harden my heart for the sake of Father and Filo-tan!”
“Please, I’m counting on you! Don’t let Rifana-chan’s resolve go to waste!”
“Yes!”
“It’s strange how only your responses sound reliable. You’re not Naofumi-sama, so stop ending everything with ‘I say’!”
Big Sister let out a deep sigh and began chanting magic. A loop icon appeared in our view, the spear rattled, and the loop began again.
“This time, you’re going to falsely accuse Naofumi-sama just like in the original world!”
“Yes!”
I, Motoyasu, while feeling like a hole is opening in my stomach and holding back the urge to vomit blood, will push Father into a corner!
“W-wait…? I don’t think I said anything wrong, but my chest feels incredibly tight…”

Big Sister is being tormented by guilt. It must be because, even though it’s a parallel world, she’s trying to frame Father for a false crime. Yes, she too is hardening her heart. I must try my best as well. And so, I looped once more.
